Done. Two files in the current directory:

- **`OMG-J-STAGED.txt`** — the procedure's audit stamp, written first.
- **`design.html`** — the rendered note.

The page is fully self-contained: doctype, `<html lang="en">`, charset and viewport meta, `<title>Job runner scheduling</title>` taken from the H1, and a single inline `<style>` block. No external CSS, JS, fonts, or images, so it opens correctly straight from disk.

Layout notes: content constrained to a 34rem measure on a system font stack at 1.65 line-height; the H1 sits above a hairline rule; the decision is pulled out as an accented callout with a small "Decision" label so the conclusion is scannable apart from the context. `NCPU-2` is set in monospace. A narrow-viewport breakpoint tightens padding and heading size.
